text.headline: Timeline of Taiwan
text.text: Major events in the history of Taiwan.

events.headline: Dutch Establish Fort Zeelandia
events.text: VOC builds Fort Zeelandia, marking the start of European colonization.

events.headline: Koxinga Expels the Dutch
events.text: Zheng Chenggong (Koxinga) drives out the Dutch.

events.headline: Qing Annexes Taiwan
events.text: Qing dynasty incorporates Taiwan as part of Fujian province.

events.headline: Japanese Rule
events.text: After the First Sino-Japanese War, China cedes Taiwan to Japan.

events.headline: Return to Chinese Control
events.text: Post-WWII, Taiwan is placed under the ROC.

events.headline: ROC Retreats to Taiwan
events.text: KMT relocates government to Taipei after civil war defeat.

events.headline: UN Seat to PRC
events.text: UN recognizes PRC as the government of China.

events.headline: End of Martial Law
events.text: Taiwan lifts martial law and liberalizes politics.
